note: The contract between the pipeline and the app. Each built file is a JSON envelope {id, kind, sources, year, built, demo, note?, citation?, data}; 'schema' describes 'data'. Group keys join parts with '|' and use '*' for 'all'. Quantile arrays hold 101 thresholds for percentiles 0..100 unless the dataset gives 'p'.

us.acs.sample.description: Weighted random sample of US adults 18+, for questions that stack several filters.
us.acs.sample.schema: {columns:[...], weight:'w', codes:{sex:['M','F'], race:['white','black','asian','hispanic','other'], marital:['never','married','previously'], state:[USPS codes]}, rows:{sex:[code index], age:[years], race:[...], marital:[...], edu:[0-4], income:[USD], kids:[0|1], bilingual:[0|1], state:[...], w:[weight]}, population: sum of weights}

us.acs.income_q.description: Personal income percentiles for adults 18+ with income above zero.

us.acs.hh_income.description: Household income adjusted to a three-person household (income x sqrt(3/size)).

us.acs.ever_married.description: Share of adults who have ever married.

us.acs.with_parents.description: Share of adults 18-40 living in a parent's home (as the householder's child).

us.acs.ownership.description: Share of householders who own their home, by age band and state.

us.acs.rent_burden.description: Gross rent as a percent of household income, renter households.

us.acs.housing.description: Median home value (owner-occupied) and median household income.

us.acs.commute_q.description: One-way travel time to work in minutes, workers who travel.

us.acs.work_hours_q.description: Usual hours worked per week, people who worked.

us.acs.children.description: Own children living in the household, for householders and their spouses or partners.

us.acs.education.schema: {levels:[5 labels, lowest first], groups:{'<band 25-34..65+|*>': [share per level]}}

us.acs.degree_earnings.description: Earnings of full-time workers 25-64 with a bachelor's degree or higher, by first field of degree.
us.acs.degree_earnings.schema: {overall:{median}, fields:{'<FOD1P code>': {label, median, p25, p75, n}}}

us.acs.couples.description: Couples sharing a household: age gaps and pairings.
us.acs.couples.schema: {gap:[101 values, years], manOlder:share, womanOlder:share, sameAge:share, eduPairs:{'<man edu>|<woman edu>': share}, racePairs:{'<man race>|<woman race>': share}, manEarnsMore:{'<man edu>|<woman edu>': share}}

us.acs.occ_pay_gap.description: Median earnings by sex for full-time workers, by Census occupation code.
us.acs.occ_pay_gap.schema: {all:{F, M}, occupations:{'<OCCP>': {label, F, M, nF, nM}}}

us.acs.languages.description: People 5+ who speak a language other than English at home.

us.acs.diaspora.description: People born outside the US, by place of birth.

us.nhis.traits.description: Orientation and smoking shares by sex and age band.

us.nsfg.marriage.description: Share of first marriages still intact after 10 and 20 years.

us.nchs.lifetable.description: US period life table by single year of age.

us.nchs.state_e0.description: Life expectancy at birth by state.

us.nchs.births_history.description: US births and total fertility rate by year.

us.cdc.causes.description: Lifetime odds of dying from selected causes. No self-harm causes.

us.bls.oews.description: Annual wage percentiles by occupation and area.
us.bls.oews.schema: {p:[10,25,50,75,90], occupations:{'<SOC>': title}, areas:{'<USPS|US>': name}, groups:{'<SOC>|<area>': [5 values]}}

us.bls.projections.schema: {baseYear, projYear, all:{change}, occupations:{'<SOC>': {title, base, proj, change}}}

us.bls.atus.description: Time use: sleep percentiles and average hours per day.

us.bls.cpi.description: Latest 12-month price change and weight for the major CPI groups.

us.bea.rpp.description: All-items regional price parity by state (US = 100).

us.fed.scf.description: Household wealth and debt percentiles by age of the head of household.
us.fed.scf.schema: {bands:['<35','35-44','45-54','55-64','65-74','75+'], networth:{groups:{'<band|*>': [101]}}, retirement:{groups:{...}}, debt:{total:{holding:{'<band|*>': share}, groups:{...}}, types:{mortgage|education|vehicle|card|other: {label, holding:{...}, groups:{...}}}}}

us.fhfa.hpi.description: Average yearly house price growth by state over the last 10 years.

us.ahs.size.description: Home floor area in square feet.

us.aei.tasks.description: Share of an occupation's tasks that appear in AI use, with the most common tasks.
us.aei.tasks.schema: {occupations:{'<SOC>': {title, taskShare, tasks:[[task text, share of AI use], ...]}}}

us.census.pop_age.description: US resident population by single year of age.

us.ssa.names.description: Babies by first name, sex and year. Sharded by the first two letters of the name, lowercase.

us.ssa.totals.description: Babies counted in the names file, by sex and year.

us.births.daily.schema: {years:[first, last], byDate:{'MM-DD': average births on that date}}

world.wpp.indicators.description: Population, births, fertility, mean age at childbearing and life expectancy by country and year.
world.wpp.indicators.schema: {first:1950, last:2030, countries:{'<ISO3|WLD>': name}, series:{'<ISO3|WLD>': {pop:[thousands], births:[thousands], tfr:[...], mac:[...], e0:[...]}}}

world.wpp.pop_age.description: Population by single year of age and sex for the current year.

world.wpp.lifetable.description: Complete life tables for the current year. Sharded by ISO3 country code.

world.pip.percentiles.description: Income or consumption per person per day (2021 PPP dollars), 100 percentiles per country, latest survey year.
world.pip.percentiles.schema: {unit:'2021 PPP $ per person per day', countries:{'<ISO3>': {year, welfare:'income'|'consumption', pop, q:[101 values]}}}

world.wdi.description: Selected World Development Indicators whose license is CC BY.

world.aei.country.description: AI usage per person by country, as an index.

world.factbook.religion.description: Religion shares by country, from the final Factbook edition.

world.oecd.housing.description: Typical home price as years of typical household income, OECD members.

world.oecd.time_use.description: Average minutes per day by activity, OECD members.

world.oecd.hours.description: Average annual hours actually worked per worker, OECD members.

my.hies.percentile.description: Monthly gross household income by percentile, Malaysia and each state.

my.wages.description: Median and mean monthly salaries and wages of Malaysian citizen employees.

my.births.daily.description: Average births per calendar date in Malaysia.
my.births.daily.schema: {years:[first, last], byDate:{'MM-DD': average births on that date}}

my.lifetables.description: Abridged life tables by state and sex (oldest group 80+).

my.population.description: Population by state, sex, five-year age group and ethnicity, latest year.

my.cpi.description: Latest 12-month price change by CPI division.

id.bps.poverty_line.description: National poverty line per person per month, and BPS's class bands as multiples of it.
id.bps.poverty_line.schema: {value: rupiah, period, bands:[[label, from multiple, to multiple], ...]}

id.bps.spending.description: Share of people in each monthly spending-per-person bracket, by province.

id.bps.wages.description: Average monthly net wages of employees.

id.bps.cpi.description: Latest 12-month price change by CPI group.
